about: Admission refuses a batch whose estimated reply would not fit the daemon's 4 MiB (4194304-byte) reply frame, before any provider call, naming items with the frame size as the limit. The estimate is 512 + the JSON-escaped batch_id and model + per item 1024 + the JSON-escaped state when options.state_text is set + per field the JSON-escaped id + 1 + the model's max_answer_bytes. With role-describe.json's max_answer_bytes, 32 one-letter fields and two items, the first batch's estimate is exactly the frame and is admitted; the second's last state is one byte longer, and it is refused.
